ruleDefinitions.name: Writing Of Malicious Files To The Fonts Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Monitors for the hiding possible malicious files in the C:\Windows\Fonts\ location. This folder doesn't require admin privillege to be written and executed from.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*copy.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*type.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*file\\ createnew.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cacls.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Fonts\\\\.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.msh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.reg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.scr.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ps.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vb.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jar.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.inf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.msi.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbs.*")))
